description:
Send sBTC from your Pillar smart wallet. Requires being connected first (use pillar_connect). Opens the frontend for signing, then waits for confirmation. Supports three recipient types: 'bns' for BNS names (muneeb.btc), 'wallet' for Pillar wallet names (iphone), 'address' for Stacks addresses (SP...).

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

recipientType.description: Type of recipient: 'bns' (default), 'wallet' for Pillar smart wallets, or 'address' for raw Stacks addresses

to.description: Recipient: BNS name (muneeb.btc), Pillar wallet name (iphone), or Stacks address (SP...)

name: pillar_send
